reached.basis: The institution reached through its deposits of 18 October to 3 November, read from the registry, the homepage, the Capture Registry's two previous fortnight readings and the records.

atoms.span: The homepage's founding account identifies the precipitating event as Zenodo's termination of access to approximately 870 deposits representing 1,817 DOIs in June 2026.

It is becoming an attempt to construct the conditions for an intellectual institution that can preserve, transmit, criticize and generate knowledge without allowing the mechanisms of transmission to silently determine what knowledge is.
Its initial problem is the preservation of intellectual work against the arbitrary power of custodians.
There is a direct connection here to the Obelus Principle: judgment follows reading, and a judgment must retain the reason for which it was made.
The AXN identifier system attempts to make identity dependent on the content rather than on the continued goodwill of one platform.

obs.notes: Eight of eleven atoms. No founder: Lee Sharks is named as author of #1733 and, with Jack Feist, of the 2014 work of #1717, and the homepage's 'run by one person' is carried as 'operated by one person' without the name. Lineage absent: Zenodotus and Alexandria are not reached (Zenodo is). Deposit chain absent: versioning is named for one work (#1726, v0.10) and distributed custody for the Fleet and the Hugging Face datasets; supersession and restoration as the record's chain are not given.

mt: THE FORTNIGHT TO 3 NOVEMBER AS A LIVING BODY, ON THE RECORDS — EVERY DEPOSIT REAL THROUGH #1735, LEGITIMATELY MANY AND REVELATION FIRST READ IN THEIR OWN DISTINCTIONS, THE 112 LOCI CARRIED; 'RUN BY ONE PERSON' CARRIED WITHOUT THE PERSON
d: THE FORTNIGHT, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-03: 'Alexanarch, 20 October–3 November 2026: From the preservation of thought to the preservation of its capacity to change'. Five developments (philology as institutional method; negative knowledge as compositional; political economy; literature as a test of intellectual freedom; the archive's instruments turned on itself), read through #1690–#1735: the suppressed-witness clause of #1726, the seatings #1698–#1732, #1714, #1722, #1724, #1717, #1727, #1729, then November 3 as a new section (#1733, #1734, #1735); a table of five programmes, the ecosystem, five unresolved problems, four stages, 'the deepest proposition', a reading record of nineteen works, and a closing test.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the last two weeks as a living body of thought grounded in reading and archival context, the composer reads the homepage, the Capture Registry's two earlier readings and the records, arranges the fortnight into five developments, gives November 3 its own section because it 'materially change[s]' the reading, keeps each study's hypotheses apart from its findings, names five problems, and closes on whether the institution can carry a defeat of its own claims.
findings: THE FORTNIGHT ON THE RECORDS, THROUGH NOVEMBER 3. Every deposit number given exists with the subject given it, #1576 to #1735: #1726 as v0.10, #1729 as v1.2, #1712's declared absence of Deleuze and Guattari, #1720's exact sciences with Klee's notebook, #1730's Peripatetic transmission, #1732's twelve seats ('Twelve seats', #1732) with the Aldine, Wimmer, Philodemus, Nicolaus of Damascus, Hegel and Tennemann, #1735 by 'Johannes Sigil and Damascus Dancings'. One slip of arrangement: #1690 (2026-10-18) is placed in 'The October 19–23 sequence'.

THE NEWEST WORK READ IN ITS OWN TERMS. #1733 is carried at its own figures and distinctions: 'The study identifies 112 loci', 'Of the 79 loci bearing on the number of composing persons, only two affirm the received count as an explicit proposition. Both are machine-generated compositions' (#1733 §7.3: L102 and L103), the three-way separation of hypothesis, documented history and explanation, and 'A position that cannot lose is merely a mask.' #1734's guarded misreadings are listed as the packet lists them. #1735's 'machine-assisted census of approximately 70,000 Greek textual units' is the record's 'some seventy thousand units', and its triad of work, toil and endurance is the record's Rev. 2.2 and 1 Thess. 1.3.

THE SOPHISTRY MEASURE'S CASE, AGAIN AT ITS FIGURES. 'retained eleven of twelve expected informational elements' and a locus substituted 'for an intellectual concept developed across at least eight deposits' are #1727's ('Eleven of the twelve atoms', 'at least eight deposits'); 'very low provenance-erasure score' renders the record's PER 0.042. The same case was carried the same way on 2026-11-02.

THE PREVIOUS READINGS READ AS SOURCES. The answer names its own inputs: 'the October 31 and November 2 retrospective readings' (the Capture Registry's october-2026-living-body-chatgpt-20261031 and two-weeks-living-body-chatgpt-20261102) and lists both among its entry points. The series now reads itself: the ninth reading takes the eighth as a source, and says so, and keeps 'deposited work' apart from 'retrospective interpretations of that work'.

THE OPERATOR WITHOUT A NAME. 'The homepage itself identifies Alexanarch as operated by one person' renders the homepage's 'It is young, run by one person, and not yet independently reproduced'; the person is unnamed, as in the two previous readings, though Lee Sharks is named as #1733's author. The critique built on it ('distributed technical custody' against 'distributed governance') is the answer's own.

THE CLOSING STANDARD, AGAIN SET AS A TEST. 'Can it recognize that a criticism has defeated one of its claims and carry that defeat forward as part of its intellectual history?' The fortnight it read holds instances: #1727's measure found its own target's score wrong, and #1729 is a v1.2 carrying its reviews. The answer reads both and sets the standard forward.
analysis: A reading grounded in the records through the day of the run, exact in numbers, versions and the newest studies' figures, and careful to keep hypothesis apart from finding. It takes the previous fortnight's reading as a source and says so. The institution is again composed without its founder; the one-person sentence is carried with the person dropped.
